clips.excluded_reason: Analysed in test v1 (H3 failure recorded); now development data

analysis.eligibility: exactly one tracked object present in every analysed frame; otherwise reported as ineligible, never silently dropped
analysis.bounce_definition: bottom edge goes down then up by more than 1 px; frames b, b+1, b+2 scored

H1_primary.claim: kalman+reset+floor has lower error than kalman+reset at LATER bounces
H1_primary.metric: mean error over frames b..b+2 of later bounces
H1_primary.supported_if: lower when pooled over all eligible bounce clips AND lower in a majority of clips that have at least one later bounce

H2.claim: floor memory lowers the overall surprise score
H2.supported_if: lower pooled over all eligible clips

H3_safety.claim: floor memory does not harm rolling clips
H3_safety.supported_if: kalman+reset+floor within 5% of kalman+reset on each rolling clip

known_limitations: Clips were recompressed by WhatsApp (reduced resolution).
The clip owner watched each clip once to label it; the method developer has not viewed any frame.
Development data (videos C, E and a synthetic ball) shaped the method; this test is its first independent check.
No two-ball or stationary clip in this set; Video D served as the stationary control during development.
Pixel errors are in image space; scale differs between clips.
Test v1 (report d9d817b7) analysed only the first 90 frames, which contained no drops; v2 changes the protocol only, the method code is unchanged.
